2026_02_PIT_NE.headline: Pittsburgh’s pass rush meets a Patriots offense getting one key back but losing secondary depth
2026_02_PIT_NE.paragraph1: Pittsburgh heads to New England without receiver Michael Pittman Jr. and cornerback Joey Porter Jr., increasing the burden on its depth at two high-leverage positions. The Patriots expect TreVeyon Henderson back, but Carlton Davis III is a major secondary concern. Pittsburgh can tilt the game by creating pressure before New England’s route concepts develop; the Patriots need their run game and quick passing structure to keep the Steelers from dictating obvious passing situations.
2026_02_PIT_NE.model_rationale: New England’s ability to stay balanced against Pittsburgh’s pressure, and the Steelers’ capacity to generate separation with a depleted receiving group, should drive down-to-down efficiency.
